prompt: Rebuild `Remaining`: report how long is left before the context's deadline, or that there is no deadline. Never report a negative time. One line is a decoy.
explain: `ctx.Deadline()` says whether a deadline exists at all. `time.Until(dl)` is deadline minus now, which is negative once it has passed, so it is clamped to zero. `time.Since` would give the opposite sign.
